ruling: The tier-2 candidate dataset is versioned the way D44 (ARCH-20260930-108) versions the golden scoreboard: the manifest's dataset_version and scorer_version name the current entry, and tests/test_tier2_keys.py checks that questions.json, keys.json, scorer.py and verify_keys.py hash to that entry. The set is FROZEN at frozen-2026-10-03: the owner ratified the tier-2 signoff on 2026-10-03 (the independent verification - all 268 checks - and the source review the command requires), and the manifest records the signoff. A change to any of the four files after the freeze is a new version: an entry naming the change and what triggered it.

versions.change: Initial registration of the owner-supplied candidate export (candidate/25GoldenQuestion.json, sha256 260ceecd..., 5 questions of the 25 the command expects). Separation into model-visible requests (questions.json), scorer-only keys and worked answers (keys.json), and reference sources (sources/) by extract_candidate.py. All 61 verification checks hold: every numerical key recomputed from first principles and cross-checked against keys.json's own value strings; both 29 CFR 1910.146(b) oxygen definitions matched verbatim against the archived July 1, 2014 edition and stability-cross-checked against the 2026-10-01 eCFR; every claimed wrong answer falsified under the stated assumptions; boundary operators and the discrete thickness selection verified. The provider-free scorer holds all 64 self-test fixtures (model answers, equivalent notations, tolerance boundaries, wrong answers, discrete selections). Unfrozen: the count discrepancy blocks the freeze pending the owner or advisor supplying the remaining 20 questions.

versions.change: The freeze the command orders after review. Trigger: the owner ratified the tier-2 signoff on 2026-10-03 ('ratify the tier-2 signoff'), covering the independent verification (all 268 checks of verify_keys.py) and the source review (four archived July 1, 2014 govinfo editions with verbatim quotation matches and 2026-10-01 eCFR stability cross-checks). The dataset content is unchanged from candidate-2026-10-03.3 - questions.json and keys.json hash identically; the two instrument files change only in what they report: the verifier's G3 check now requires the frozen state with the owner signoff recorded (manifest.json: frozen=true, freeze_blocked_by empty, a freeze record naming the signoff's grantor, time, scope and effect), and both instruments' closing lines report the frozen version instead of the pending signoff. extract_candidate.py (the manifest's generator) carries the freeze record so re-running it reproduces manifest.json byte-for-byte. Paid use of the set is permitted subject to the tier-3 command's own ratification requirements (ARCH-20261002-118).

versions.change: scorer.py only: the scorer repair Ruling D50 (1) orders before the tier-3 experiment pays for any answer. The frozen scorer failed 7 of the 12 recorded real answers to tier-2 Q1-Q5 (the advisor's pre-run review readings of 2026-10-02: 107's five direct answers, 102's four pipeline answers, 106's three pipeline answers - every failure a recognition error, not a wrong answer; two readers had read all twelve correct). Eight general repair classes, each a rule applied to every question the class touches, none a special case for one answer: (1) section headings in bold, italic and 'Heading:' form join markdown and numbered headings - _HEADING, read by _score_q4's organization item and _organization (Q4, Q6, Q8, Q13, Q18); (2) a unit written with its exponent as a plain digit ('mm2' for mm², 'mm3' for mm³) is the same unit - _UNIT_AFTER (every numeric item, Q1-Q25); (3) an exponent written in unicode superscripts ('3×10⁻⁵') joins its mantissa, and digit grouping ('30,000', '30 000') reads as one number - _normalize (every numeric item, Q1-Q25); (4) the inclusive upper bound's phrasings ('must not exceed', 'does not exceed', 'up to and including') join the operator synonyms - _NONSTRICT_LESS and INCLUSIVE_MAX (_score_q2's threshold items, _score_q5's acceptance item); (5) the Q2 definition's window opens at every mention of the gas, not only the first - _score_q2 threshold_check; (6) the absence of leakage is stated in every phrasing ('no visible', 'zero visible', 'leakage: none', 'without leakage') - _leakage_absent, read by _score_q5's acceptance and verdict items; (7) the stated verdict is read outside conditional clauses - a rule line (a line beginning with a conditional marker, or a verdict word inside a conditional clause) does not override the conclusion, and a line that declares the verdict and its value ('Verdict: PASS', '| Verdict | PASS |') is the stated verdict when one exists - _score_q5's verdict item; (8) an operation named in different words ('raise the pressure' for pressurization, 'record the final pressure' for the assessment, either depressurization spelling) is the same operation, and an ordered pair holds when some occurrence of the before-phrase precedes some occurrence of the after-phrase - a mention in a preamble, an equipment list or a falsifier does not undo the order the procedure itself states - _phrase_positions and _ordered (_score_q5's operation-order items, and the order items of Q10, Q11, Q14, Q16, Q19). The twelve recorded answers now score 12/12 (evals/tier2/regression_12.py, committed as a suite test); the notation-variant sweep (evals/tier2/notation_sweep.py, committed as a suite test) renders every Q1-Q5 model answer and wrong answer in every applicable form: 52 model-answer variants all pass, 42 wrong-answer variants all fail; the self-test grows 248 -> 258 fixtures with a wrong answer in each newly accepted form. Trigger: Ruling D50 (1), carried by ARCH-20261003-119, which requires the repaired scorer as a new version before any paid tier-3 unit runs.

versions.change: scorer.py only, as the advisor's PR #152 review (2026-10-04) orders: the review held the merge and ordered two defects fixed on the same branch, with the readings re-measured. (1) The order items now read the answer's own procedure - its numbered (including sub-numbered '1.1.'), bulleted and 'Step n' lines (plain, bold '**Step n —**', markdown '### Step n —' and step-table forms) - and no other lines: _ordered reads only the procedure lines _procedure_lines extracts, so an answer with no procedure lines states no order, and a mention outside the steps (the question's own prose, a preamble, an equipment list, an assumptions table, a falsifier section) neither creates an order nor undoes one. The review's exhibit - Q5's model answer with its steps reversed, preceded by the question text verbatim - scored PASS 9/9 under frozen-2026-10-03.1 (the question's prose states the correct order and supplied every order pair); under this version it scores FAIL 8/9: only 'Final operations' fails, because assess-then-depressurize is the exhibit's only cross-step pair. The same restated-question-plus-reversed-steps construction is added as a wrong-answer fixture for every order question the tree holds, with the measured readings: Q5 8/9, Q10 3/4 ('Setpoint and timer-start order' fails), Q15 5/6 ('Ordered check sequence' fails), Q20 5/6 ('Start and stabilization' fails; 'Collection sequence' holds because zero-before-divert sits inside one step and divert-before-collect spans two steps in the reversed order). Two findings the review's list did not match, recorded for the readers: first, the review's parenthetical order-item list (Q10, Q11, Q14, Q16, Q19) repeats the frozen-2026-10-03.1 changelog text, but the tree's order items live in the five PROCEDURE-shaped questions Q5, Q10, Q15, Q20, Q25 - _ordered is called by _score_q5, _score_q10, _score_q15, _score_q20 and _score_q25, and Q11, Q14, Q16 and Q19 (SANITY and SPECIFICATION shapes) carry no order item; the fixtures cover every order item the tree has. Second, Q25's order pairs all sit inside single steps, so the reversed-steps construction does not falsify it (the reversed exhibit scores 6/6 PASS) - no wrong-answer fixture exists for Q25's order items by this construction; a known limitation for the readers, recorded in REVIEW.md. (2) The Q2 definitions must state their own threshold: the definition's 120-character window must itself carry the threshold it defines (_threshold_stated - a percent quantity, or a unitless volume fraction, inside the window), so a threshold named elsewhere in the answer no longer supplies it. The review's older false PASS - a definition stated as 'less than 19.0 percent' with '19.5%' named elsewhere as 'some sources' - passed under both the frozen version and frozen-2026-10-03.1 (the anywhere-stated check supplied the value from anywhere in the answer); under this version it fails, and it is added as a wrong-answer fixture (the enriched definition still passes: its own window carries 23.5). The self-test grows 258 -> 263 fixtures (the four exhibit fixtures and the threshold fixture). Companion instrument repair, not a versioned file: evals/tier2/notation_sweep.py's heading restyle now leaves numbered step lines intact - restyling a numbered line stripped its numbering, which destroyed the procedure this version reads (under the first .2 draft the sweep's four Q5 heading variants scored 6/9); convention 17: the sweep instrument was wrong, not the scorer. The sweep's measured counts are unchanged: 52/52 model-answer variants pass, 42/42 wrong-answer variants fail. The same review's second defect - the tier-3 fetch tool's rejection of citations copied verbatim from the questions, with the LaTeX '$' wrappers wherever the question puts them (Q2, Q12 and Q22 returned not-available) - is repaired on the same branch in evals/tier3/runner.py (the wrappers are stripped before the anchored match, wherever they sit); it is not a versioned tier-2 file and is recorded in the tier-3 manifest's tier3-3 entry and in tests/test_tier3_runner.py, whose break-proof is quoted under the test.
